whenToUse: Weighty large headings, such as a campaign or collection launch.
Two or three short lines on a dark background.
Lines with an order, such as release dates.
whenNotToUse: Small text (the motion is hard to see).
Long sentences whose line breaks differ by screen.

alternatives.name: Staggered Text Reveal
alternatives.reason: Appearing through opacity without a mask.

accessibility: Screen readers get every line at once via sr-only text.
With reduced motion, they show at once.
Padding below each line box keeps descenders and final consonants from being cut off.
